focus.name: shared-collision-and-vram-services
focus.purpose: Replace the remaining generic Block label on the shared player-collision service, clarify its compact dispatch trampoline, and name the fixed-word VRAM transfer by its exact payload.

targets.name: SceneResource_CopyFixedWordsToD000
targets.contract: Copy 0x800 words from ROM 0x0011E0A0 to VRAM destination 0xD000 through VDP_CopyWordsToVRAM.

targets.name: PlayerCollision_DelegateToSharedResponse
targets.contract: Execute the six-byte BSR.W/RTS trampoline into Actor_ProcessSharedPlayerCollision without adding local player or scene-state writes.

targets.name: Actor_ProcessSharedPlayerCollision
targets.contract: Process shared player-collision state, actor-side position and timer fields, and terminal type-0x84 cleanup/initialization branches.

contracts: All promoted entries retain their exact fixed-ROM addresses, ranges, and callers.
The canonical names distinguish a VRAM word transfer, a dispatch trampoline, and the shared collision-response service.
Every prior canonical or dispatch-derived label remains available as an explicit alias.
limitations: The shared collision-service name does not claim a user-facing actor type for every branch.
The VRAM-transfer name describes the fixed transfer contract and not the higher-level scene mode that calls it.
